intro: A Noble Brew is the culmination of a covert scheme orchestrated from the shady cellar beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. Operating at the behest of Zardeth of the Black Claw, an unwitting or uncaring courier delivers a potent concoction known as Black Claw Stout to Lord Baurles K. Wishock inside the Royal Keep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lord Wishock, like all men, has his weaknesses. His happens to be a fondness for liquor. The hypocrisy is astounding. The trite fool spends his days trying to shut down our little "tavern" while his nights are spent upstairs, running up a bill he never pays. Well, let's see how Wishock likes this special brew I have prepared for him: Black Claw stout. It's got quite a kick, friend.
Take it to him and see how he likes it. Most likely the old fool is milling about the Hall of Petitioners.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Can you not see that I am busy? My words must be heard! I am very important to the future of this Kingdom!
Oh... What have you there? Why it looks like a refreshing drink...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, thank you for bringing me this fine looking stout, servant. Here's a copper for you. Now, out of sight with you and let me enjoy my drink!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
